name: EWC (diagonal Fisher)
tagline: Elastic Weight Consolidation: estimate the diagonal Fisher information after each context (label-weighted squared gradients) and add a 0.5 * F * (theta-theta*)^2 penalty.
pseudocode:
1. Switch model to eval; iterate up to 200 batches of size 1.
2. For each example, compute output logits and softmax weights $p_y = \mathrm{softmax}(\text{out})$.
3. For each label $y$: compute $-\log p_y$ via cross-entropy and backprop.
4. Accumulate $F_n \mathrel{+}= p_y\,(\partial_n)^2$ for every parameter $n$.
5. Average: $F_n \leftarrow F_n / N$.
6. Penalty when learning later contexts: $\mathcal{L}_{\text{reg}} = 0.5 \sum_n F_n\,(\theta_n - \theta_n^\star)^2$.
diff_from_baseline: Kirkpatrick et al., "Overcoming catastrophic forgetting" (PNAS 2017). Diagonal Fisher importance and quadratic penalty around previous-context parameters; classic regularization-based continual learner.

name: Online EWC
tagline: EWC with exponential decay across contexts: F_t = gamma * F_{t-1} + F_new (gamma=0.9), keeping a single running Fisher.
pseudocode:
1. Set $\gamma = 0.9$ (model.gamma).
2. Compute fresh diagonal Fisher $F_{\text{new}}$ exactly as in EWC (200 samples, label-weighted squared grads).
3. Decay-and-merge: $F_n \leftarrow \gamma F_n^{\text{old}} + F_{\text{new}, n}$.
4. Return delta $F_{\text{new}, n} - F_n^{\text{old}}$ so the harness's accumulator stores the new merged Fisher.
5. Penalty: $\mathcal{L}_{\text{reg}} = 0.5\,\gamma \sum_n F_n\,(\theta_n - \theta_n^\star)^2$.
diff_from_baseline: Schwarz et al., "Progress & Compress" (ICML 2018). Variant of EWC that maintains a single Fisher matrix, exponentially decayed and additively merged with each new context; reduces to standard EWC when gamma=1.

name: Synaptic Intelligence
tagline: Synaptic Intelligence: per-step path-integral W tracks how each parameter contributes to loss reduction, then omega = W / (delta^2 + eps) drives a quadratic penalty.

key_hyperparams.name: W tracker
key_hyperparams.role: per-step path integral updated by mid_edit hook

diff_from_baseline: Zenke et al., "Continual Learning Through Synaptic Intelligence" (ICML 2017). Online importance estimate using the per-step contribution to loss reduction, normalized by squared parameter change; a path-integral alternative to Fisher-based EWC.
